description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the {@link MicrometerBasedMetrics} class, verifying its behavior in metrics reporting, tenant timeout handling, and connection tracking within an Eclipse Hono service component.

classes.name: MicrometerBasedMetricsTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of MicrometerBasedMetrics, including telemetry reporting, timeout management, and connection tracking.

methods.name: registries
methods.description: Provides a stream of different MeterRegistry instances (Prometheus and Graphite) for parameterized tests.

methods.name: testReportTelemetryWithOptionalQos
methods.description: Verifies telemetry reporting with optional QoS tags and TTD status.

methods.name: testReportTelemetryWithUnknownTagValues
methods.description: Ensures that unknown QoS and TTD status values result in expected tags in metrics.

methods.name: testPayloadSizeForTelemetryMessages
methods.description: Checks payload size calculation for telemetry messages considering minimum message size configurations.

methods.name: testPayloadSizeForCommandMessages
methods.description: Checks payload size calculation for command messages with minimum size enforcement.

methods.name: testNoTenantTimeoutOnDefault
methods.description: Verifies that tenant timeout collection is disabled by default.

methods.name: testTimeoutEvent
methods.description: Tests that a tenant's timeout is scheduled when a message is sent.

methods.name: testTimeoutRemovesMetrics
methods.description: Checks that metrics are removed after tenant timeout expires.

methods.name: testLastSeenIsUpdatedOnMessageSend
methods.description: Ensures sending a message updates the tenant's last seen timestamp.

methods.name: testLastSeenIsUpdatedOnDisconnect
methods.description: Verifies that disconnect updates the tenant's last seen timestamp.

methods.name: testLastSeenIsUpdatedOnConnect
methods.description: Verifies that connecting updates the tenant's last seen timestamp.

methods.name: configWithTenantIdleTimeout
methods.description: Helper to create a ProtocolAdapterProperties instance with a specific tenant idle timeout.

methods.name: reportTelemetry
methods.description: Helper method to report telemetry with default parameters for tests.

methods.name: reportCommand
methods.description: Helper method to report command message metrics for tests.
